Purpose: Reference for AI agents working on the Rusty Commit codebase. Project: Rusty Commit (`rco`) - AI-powered commit message generator in Rust. Repository: https://github.com/hongkongkiwi/rusty-commit. Version: 1.0.24 | Last Updated: 2026-02-02. Binary Name: `rco` (also `rusty-commit`). Code Size: ~15,500 lines across 58 source files. Architecture: Trait-based provider system, async/await with tokio. Key Dependencies: tokio 1.35, clap 4.5, git2 0.20, async-openai 0.32, rmcp 0.13.

`git push`, `git reset --hard`, `git clean -fd`  
`rm -rf` or deleting files outside project dir  
Modifying system files or installing system packages  
**Never hardcode or log** API keys/tokens  
**Verify `.gitignore`** excludes sensitive files before committing  
Use `keyring` for secure storage (falls back to file with 0o600 perms)  
**No `unwrap()`** in production paths (use `?`)  
| Diff > 5,000 lines | Request user to stage specific files |  
| 2,000-5,000 lines | Use subagents for parallel exploration |  
| Multiple independent modules | Spawn parallel tasks |

CLI (cli.rs) → Commands (commands/) → Providers (providers/) → Utils (utils/)  
pub trait AIProvider: Send + Sync { async fn generate_commit_message(&self, diff: &str, context: Option<&str>) -> Result<String>; }
